reviews.t: Also washes out easily at bath time
reviews.x: I had not been able to keep the shorter hair out of my yorkie's eyes until I bought this.  It only takes a tiny dab to keep hair in place.  It dries fast, is not sticky, and brushes out.  Also washes out easily at bath time.  Love it!

I needed a gel to hold the short hair of my Maltese puppy's topknot. I'm not very pleased because it discolors his white hair by giving it a slight yellow tint. I expected the gel to be clear and this is yellowish.  However, it is quite sticky and holds the hair in place.  Maybe my jar isn't fresh and possibly it should be clear but, I would be leery of trying this product again.

reviews.t: Smells nice but not very strong
reviews.x: I have a big and wirey hair husky-golden retriever-poodle mix. His eyebrows will grow out long and cover his eyes so I got the hair gel to slick them back. It would work for about 5-10 minutes, but then if he start to run/jump around and play they would fall right back. His hair is very thick and heavy and I did not have it tied in a top knot, so I'm sure on other dogs it would work fine, it just wasn't right for him. I ultimately ended up trimming his eyebrows because nothing would work to hold

I've bought bows and rubber bands but her hair comes out from the bands. This gel keeps it all locked up and she looks great! Even with her running around and playing with her toys and rolling around. Not only does this too knot gel do the job but it smells so good! reviews.t: Keeps puppy and dog fly-away hairs firmly in their bands
reviews.x: This stuff is amazing!  I didn't even know such a product existed and was excited to try it when I found it.  My baby shih tzu has a top knot that's in the awkward stage where most will stay in a band or clip but the lower pieces fall down into her eyes.  I applied a bit of this and all the hair is staying put, LOVE THIS SO MICH!  This tub will probably last me awhile but when it's gone I will be back to buy more.

reviews.x: Great grooming product for controlling hair.  Not much product needed, so this will last a long time.  A must have for dogs with top knots.

claims.text: Many reviewers say it effectively holds fly-away hair and top knots in place, often needing only a tiny amount.
Several reviewers note the gel is yellowish and discolors or makes white hair look dingy.
Some reviewers find it too stiff, clumpy, gooey, or messy to work with.
A few reviewers say it does not hold well on thick or wiry hair, with fly-aways falling back quickly.
Some reviewers praise that it washes out easily and brushes out without stickiness.
